name: Glass Heart Princess
source: The protagonist is beautiful, smart, and good at sports.  She is the perfect daughter of a respected family. However, she is suddenly stricken with a bizarre disease called "Glass Heart Syndrome".  If her heart rate rises above normal, she will die. The only cure is to train her heart by experiencing heart-pounding situations through dating!
translation: 主人公美丽、聪明、擅长运动。她是一个受人尊敬的家庭的完美女儿。然而，她突然患上了一种叫做“玻璃心综合征”的怪病。如果心率超过正常值，她就会死亡。唯一的治疗方法是通过约会来体验令人心跳加速的场景，以此锻炼她的心脏！
